tasks.name: P0.1: Add messages table to SQLite schema
tasks.desc: Create a messages table in the SQLite schema for server-side message persistence. Columns: conversationId, role, parts (JSON), createdAt, metadata. Use WAL mode for non-blocking writes. On startup, rehydrate sessions from DB.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: Root cause: SessionStore is purely in-memory Map<string, AgentSession>. AgentSession holds messages as UIMessage[] — all lost on process exit. SQLite already exists for metadata but has no messages table.

checks: messages table created with conversationId, role, parts, createdAt, metadata columns
WAL mode enabled for non-blocking writes
On startup, sessions rehydrated from DB if messages exist
Schema migration is idempotent (safe to run multiple times)

tasks.name: P0.2: Periodic message flush during execution
tasks.desc: Add checkpoint mechanism in chat-service.ts that writes partial messages to SQLite at regular intervals — every tool call result or every N tokens. Use debounced writes (batch every 5s, not per-message).

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: Messages only saved in onFinish callback — if server dies mid-stream, onFinish never fires and no partial response is saved anywhere.

checks: Partial messages flushed to SQLite during streaming
Debounced writes (batch every 5s)
Flush triggers on tool call results
Does not block the main streaming path

tasks.name: P0.3: Pre-exit state flush in stop()
tasks.desc: Before process.exit() in main.ts stop(), iterate all sessions in SessionStore, write messages + metadata to SQLite, record which turns were in-flight. Should take <100ms for typical session counts.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: stop() does immediate process.exit() without flushing any sessions. Comment says it's intentional for port-release speed. Need to add flush before exit.

checks: All sessions flushed to SQLite before process.exit()
In-flight turns recorded for potential resume
Flush takes <100ms for typical session count (<20 sessions)
process.exit() still happens after flush (no hang)

tasks.name: P0.4: SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful flush
tasks.desc: Update SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers in index.ts to flush sessions before calling stop(). Consider process.on('beforeExit') as last-resort safety net. Chromium auto-update gives ~5s window.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers just call stop() which does process.exit(). No beforeExit handler. Chromium auto-update sends SIGTERM with ~5s window.

checks: SIGTERM handler flushes sessions before exit
SIGINT handler flushes sessions before exit
Flush completes within 5s (Chromium auto-update window)
beforeExit handler as last-resort safety net

tasks.name: P1.5: Save partial messages on abort (server-side)
tasks.desc: On abort signal in chat-service.ts, save current messages snapshot to SQLite before the abort propagates. Don't discard partial responses.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: When user clicks stop, abort fires but onFinish may not save the partial response. Partial messages with empty parts get filtered out by useEffect.

checks: Abort signal handler saves current messages to SQLite
Partial responses preserved, not discarded
No blocking of the abort signal propagation

tasks.name: P1.6: Wire getConversationMessages in compaction route
tasks.desc: Replace the `return null` stub in compaction route with actual lookup from SessionStore. Wire SessionStore to the compaction route in server.ts.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: getConversationMessages always returns null — SessionStore is not shared with chat routes. The compaction route cannot access message history.

checks: getConversationMessages returns actual messages from DB/SessionStore
SessionStore wired to compaction route in server.ts
Compaction can access full message history

tasks.name: P1.7: Implement compact endpoint
tasks.desc: Implement the stub POST /assistant/sessions/:id/compact endpoint. Should trigger compaction for the given session and return result.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: Endpoint exists but is a stub — just returns { success: true, message: 'Compaction scheduled' } without doing anything.

checks: Compact endpoint triggers actual compaction
Returns compaction result (summary, token count)
Handles edge case: session not found
Handles edge case: session has no messages

tasks.name: P1.8: Save partial messages on abort (client-side)
tasks.desc: In useChatSession.ts, save current messages on abort before filtering. Don't filter out partial assistant messages — mark them as interrupted instead.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: Client only saves on status='ready'. Abort transitions to ready but partial messages with empty parts get filtered out by useEffect.

checks: Messages saved on abort before filtering
Partial assistant messages marked as interrupted, not discarded
conversationStorage updated with partial state

tasks.name: P2.9: Add beforeunload handler in sidepanel
tasks.desc: Add beforeunload and visibilitychange handlers in sidepanel that synchronously write current messages to chrome.storage.local. Handles panel close, refresh, and Chromium kill.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: No beforeunload handler exists. Closing sidepanel mid-stream loses any un-saved messages. chrome.storage.local has 10MB limit per extension.

checks: beforeunload handler writes messages to chrome.storage.local
visibilitychange handler also triggers save
Synchronous write (navigator.sendBeacon or localStorage fallback)
No performance impact on normal operation

tasks.name: P2.10: Persist compaction state across restarts
tasks.desc: Persist compaction summary text + count alongside messages in DB. Load when rebuilding a session. Prevents context overflow after restart.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: CompactionState is ephemeral — lives in prepareStep closure. On restart, compaction summary is lost, next turn starts fresh.

checks: Compaction state persisted to DB alongside messages
State loaded when rebuilding a session
Handles missing/empty state gracefully

tasks.name: P2.11: Persist turn frames for active sessions
tasks.desc: Add SQLite backing for turn frames. The ring buffer can still be used for hot-path reads, but should be backed by durable storage.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: TurnRegistry is ring buffer with 5k frames, 5min retain. Older frames silently dropped. On restart all turn history is lost.

checks: Turn frames persisted to SQLite for active sessions
Ring buffer still used for hot-path reads
Frames recoverable after restart
No performance regression on hot path

tasks.name: P3.12: Session rehydration on startup
tasks.desc: On server startup, check for existing messages in DB and rehydrate sessions. Must not start serving until DB load completes.

comments.author: investigation
comments.body: Currently no session rehydration. After restart, all sessions start empty. Client sends previousConversation as injection but server-side state (MCP connections, tool configs) is lost.

checks: On startup, sessions rehydrated from DB if messages exist
Server does not accept requests until rehydration completes
MCP connections and tool configs are re-initialized
Handles corrupted/missing session data gracefully
